part.text:
Validation is implemented and all project checks pass.

## What changed

**`src/validation.ts`**
- `validateCreateUser` now accepts `unknown` request data and validates the body itself:
  - Non-object bodies (`null`, arrays, primitives, missing body) → `BODY_ERROR`.
  - `email`: must be a string, ≤254 chars, single `@` with a dotted domain (`EMAIL_PATTERN`); returned trimmed.
  - `name`: must be a non-empty string after trimming, ≤100 chars.
  - `age`: optional, but when present must be a non-negative integer.
  - Unsupported fields are rejected via `UNKNOWN_FIELD_ERROR_TEMPLATE`/`FIELD_PLACEHOLDER`, so typos and extra fields don't get silently dropped.
  - All errors are collected, not short-circuited, so a client gets the full list.
- New `createUserEndpoint(input)` maps the result to the HTTP boundary: `{ status: 400, body: { errors } }` on rejection, `{ status: 200, body: { user } }` with the normalized user on success.
- All messages/statuses are named exported constants (`EMAIL_ERROR`, `NAME_ERROR`, `AGE_ERROR`, `BODY_ERROR`, `HTTP_OK`, `HTTP_BAD_REQUEST`) rather than inline literals; no comments were added beyond JSDoc contracts.

**`src/validation.test.ts`** (new, picked up by the existing `dist/*.test.js` glob)
- Valid: complete request, request without optional `age`, whitespace trimming/normalization, 200 with normalized user.
- Invalid: missing email, missing name, malformed email (`a@b`, `@b.co`, `a b@c.co`, non-string, empty…), malformed name (`""`, `"   "`, non-string), malformed age (`-1`, `1.5`, `"30"`, `NaN`, `null`), non-object bodies, unsupported field, all-failures-at-once, and 400 responses.

**`examples/typescript/README.md`** — dropped the now-stale "incomplete input validation" weakness bullet.

## Checks

```
npm run build  → tsc, no errors
npm run lint   → tsc --noEmit, no errors
npm test       → 19 tests, 19 pass, 0 fail
```

Existing `app.test.ts` expectations (`{ ok: true, errors: [] }`, `/email/` match) still hold. Changes are left unstaged for your review.

Suggested commit message: `feat(examples/typescript): validate create-user payload and return 400 on invalid input`
